My name is Alexis Kemp-Sagert, and I would love to be your trusted real estate expert. With over 4 years of experience, more than $70 million in real estate sold, and having helped over 275 families achieve their real estate goals, I bring proven results and an in-depth understanding of the local market. I am proud to be recognized as a Top 10 agent in the MLS for the past three consecutive years, as well as a RE/MAX Torchbearer the past 3 years, placing me among the Top 5 Iowa RE/MAX agents under 40. These honors reflect my commitment to excellence, consistent performance, and exceptional client service. With a passion for residential real estate, I have successfully guided clients through every stage of the buying, selling, and investing process—ensuring their needs are met and their goals realized.
